This document pins the citation/bibliography rendering fixes. Each paragraph cites
an entry that exercises one fix, and the page supplies its own `# References`
heading so the auto-generated list must render under it (no duplicate heading).

Kernel methods were popularised by a line of work surveyed in
[@muller2018kernel]; the surname accents (`M{\"u}ller`, `Sch{\"o}lkopf`) must
render as Unicode.

The random-graph model of [@erdos1959random] uses the Hungarian double-acute
accent (`Erd{\H{o}}s`), which must compose to "Erdős".

Air-quality limits are set by a corporate author [@who2021guidelines]: a
brace-protected name must render whole, never initialised to "W. H. Organization".

The `@string` macro `springer` is referenced by both a book [@bishop2006pattern]
and a book chapter [@bengio2012practical]; the chapter is an `@incollection`, so
its `booktitle` and `pages` must appear.
